title: Smooth glancing regularity in parabolic windows
reviewed_arguments: All 48 obligations, all 37 unchanged displays, all three complete solutions and the original exact diagram remain.
The full smooth single-face time-variable scalar principal form, arbitrary complex matrix lower coefficients and both weak form domains are retained.
Actual same-space and antidual transfers, finite supported phase partitions and both directions of the closure-of-union identity are proved.
The guard uses the complete square-root quadratic-form remainder at mean k-1/2 and retains the normal x factor and exact absorption coefficient.
Negative tangential coercivity retains all variable coefficients, the strict square root, full separated cutoff errors and the weak normal factors.
The full ordered interior parametrix acts on the natural antidual through a proved compact L2 derivative decomposition; all source residuals remain.
The compressed characteristic image, both ordinary lifts, boundary limits and noncharacteristic energy-front containment are proved.
The independent guard induction leaves one fixed neighborhood; increasing finite-order constants do not shrink it away.
The positive induction uses the exact energy output, genuine incoming threshold, strict beta margins and independent guard coverage.
Every full microsupport and residual family can be enlarged inside the preceding elliptic union. One compact inner region works at every order.
Both signed clocks preserve the positive factor and every source, lower and normal-error absolute bound without time-stationary assumptions.
The uniform two-point inverse-coordinate bound and transverse flow Taylor remainder give the precise quadratic window constants on compact anchor sets.
The parabolic criterion removes characteristic incoming points and uses proved ellipticity for every noncharacteristic incoming point.
The U056 identification retains its extra b-identically-zero collar hypothesis, actual field sign, time scale and all normal lifts.
The third solution now has the correct neighborhood cutoff, complete Sobolev convergence, jump derivative and sharp Fourier threshold on both signs.
Four finite model groups supplement the complete proofs. All eighteen final lesson captures, including the diagram and two mobile samples, were inspected.
later_scope_not_claimed: Non-glancing analytic propagation and full singular trajectories
Remaining corners, systems, crossings and complex phases
